sections.heading: Description of Property Insured
sections.body: Building including plinth and foundation, medical equipment, furniture, fixtures and fittings, electrical installations, and stocks of medicines and consumables kept at the location of risk stated in this schedule, as per the declaration submitted by the Insured. Sum insured for buildings is on reinstatement value basis.

sections.heading: Perils Covered
sections.body: Fire, lightning, explosion or implosion, aircraft damage, riot, strike and malicious damage, storm, cyclone, typhoon, tempest, hurricane, tornado, flood and inundation, earth tremor and landslide, bush fire, impact damage, subsidence, missile testing operations, leakage from automatic sprinkler installations, and theft within seven days of the occurrence of an insured peril, subject to the policy wording.

sections.heading: Add-on Covers and Clauses
sections.body: Earthquake (fire and shock) cover included. Terrorism cover included as per the Indian Market Terrorism Risk Insurance Pool terms. Agreed Bank Clause, Designation of Property Clause, Reinstatement Value Clause, and Escalation Clause apply as attached.

sections.heading: Important Conditions
sections.body: This policy is issued on the basis of the proposal and declaration dated at inception. The Insured shall give immediate notice of any loss to the issuing office and shall take all reasonable steps to minimise loss. Premium has been received under Section 64VB of the Insurance Act, 1938. In case of any grievance, the Insured may contact the Grievance Redressal Officer at the issuing office or approach the Insurance Ombudsman, Kochi.

sections.heading: Declaration
sections.body: This schedule forms part of the Bharat Laghu Udyam Suraksha Policy wording, which should be read together with this schedule, endorsements and clauses attached. Stamp duty has been paid by consolidated payment as per the applicable State order.
